fixed_bout_segmentation.inter_bout_reset_gate: force valley below 0.35 of the smaller adjacent peak
fixed_bout_segmentation.target_availability_gate: at least one target-mesh filename in every bout window

registered_task.interpretation: retrospective selection of one reset-separated diagnostic poke to predict the fifth recorded poke
registered_task.causal_limit: all bouts were recorded sequentially; this is not randomized online policy execution

response_functional.geometry: symmetric Euclidean Chamfer between the input template mesh and the target mesh nearest the force peak
response_functional.normalization: divide Chamfer by input-template bounding-box diagonal
response_functional.model_scale: natural logarithm of normalized Chamfer plus 1e-9
response_functional.mesh_sampling: deterministic at most 2048 OBJ vertices using evenly spaced source indices
response_functional.target_topology_requirement: none; no same-index or persistent-vertex assumption

registered_policies.generic_information: candidate with largest source marginal log-response variance
registered_policies.random_cost_matched: uniform expected loss over the four candidate bouts
registered_policies.dependence_destroyed: cyclically permute complete challenge responses across source objects while preserving candidate and challenge marginals

requirements: task-conditioned and generic-information select different candidates on the complete source fit
task-conditioned mean leave-one-out squared log-error is lower than generic-information
task-conditioned mean leave-one-out squared log-error is lower than no-probe
matched task value is greater than dependence-destroyed task value
source_gate.failure_action: retain source-negative result and do not open calibration or target geometry

requirements: task-conditioned total squared log-error across both calibration objects is lower than generic-information
task-conditioned total squared log-error across both calibration objects is lower than no-probe
neither calibration object has task-conditioned squared log-error above twice its no-probe squared log-error plus 1e-12
calibration_gate.failure_action: retain calibration-negative result and keep all three target objects closed

target_policy.minimum_status_after_positive_calibratio: separate reviewed target-opening commit and exact source/calibration artifact bindings
target_policy.claim_if_eventually_positive: pilot evidence only; three target objects are insufficient for an arbitrary-object generalization claim

claim_boundary: This prelock can establish source/calibration feasibility of task-conditioned diagnostic-poke selection. It cannot establish online intervention execution, safety, persistent material-point identity, calibrated real posterior uncertainty, or broad object generalization.
